map.做多房间批量初配时，先统一用面积法得出各间基准匹数，再对特殊房间单独加余量，减少: When doing a first-pass sizing for several rooms, use the area method uniformly to get a baseline tonnage for each room, then add margin to the special rooms, which reduces the cost of item-by-item calculation.
map.出租房或办公室按面积快速配机，套入『面积×层高×指标』即可得出制冷量，再除以 2: To size units quickly for a rental flat or office, plug into area x ceiling height x index to get the cooling load, then divide by 2324 to get the tonnage; the whole process can be done in your head.
map.变频和定频影响选型吗？: Does variable frequency versus fixed frequency affect the choice?
map.变频机低频稳温更省电，可按基准匹数选；定频机频繁启停，建议留 10%–20% 余: A variable-frequency unit holds temperature more steadily at low output and saves power, so it can be chosen at the baseline tonnage; a fixed-frequency unit starts and stops frequently, so leave 10%-20% margin to avoid long runs at part load.
map.向客户或家人解释为什么『10㎡ 用 1 匹、20㎡ 用 2 匹』时，用面积法最直: When explaining to a client or family why "10 m2 needs 1 ton and 20 m2 needs 2 tons", the area method is the most intuitive way to set expectations.
map.层高超过 3m 怎么处理？: What if the ceiling height exceeds 3 m?
map.层高越高单位面积负荷越大，公式中层高直接乘入；挑空客厅建议按实际体积并叠加 20: The higher the ceiling, the greater the load per unit area, and the ceiling height multiplies directly into the formula; for a double-height living room, work from the actual volume and add 20% margin.
map.空调匹数选择指南（按面积） 使用指南: Air conditioner tonnage selection guide (by area) guide
map.输入房间面积、空间类型、层高与朝向，自动估算所需制冷量并推荐空调匹数，适用于新房: Enter the room area, space type, ceiling height and orientation to estimate the required cooling load and recommend an air conditioner tonnage. Suitable for new home purchase and unit sizing reference.
map.面积法为什么有时偏大？: Why is the area method sometimes too large?
map.面积法用统一指标，未扣除墙体/家具占用与人员密度差异；密闭好、人少的房间实际负荷: The area method uses a uniform index and does not deduct for walls, furniture and differences in occupant density; a well-sealed room with few people has a lower actual load, so the tonnage can be reduced by half a unit.
map.面积法速算: Quick sizing by the area method
map.：使用面积 15㎡，层高 2.8m\n制冷量 = 15 × 2.8 × 200:
: usable area 15 m2, ceiling height 2.8 m.
Cooling load = 15 x 2.8 x 200 is about 8400 W.
8400 / 2324 is about 3.6 tons, so choose two 1.5-ton units or one 3-ton cabinet unit
